Please check back soon.AboutWrestleMania returns to Las Vegas for the second consecutive year as Allegiant Stadium hosts the biggest event of the year over two nights on Saturday, April 18 and Sunday, April 19, 2026! WWE's Las Vegas takeover will feature can't-miss action headlined by its biggest Superstars, including Roman Reigns, CM Punk, Brock Lesnar, Cody Rhodes, Becky Lynch, Charlotte Flair, Rhea Ripley, Jade Cargill and more. Witness your favorite Superstars from Monday Night RAW and Friday Night SmackDown as they take the stage at the Showcase of the Immortals! Ticket purchasers will have an opportunity to purchase a commemorative WrestleMania chair, a commemorative limited edition WrestleMania magnet and souvenir ticket during the purchase process.
